meaning: score 0..1 (size fit after the suggested scale, proportions, roof); fit_err_pct: size error left after scale, shape_err_pct: proportion mismatch (at one uniform scale), raw_err_pct: size error at scale 1; scale is x,y,z of the row; yaw_deg: spawn yaw that lays the row on the object (trees: any); scan_plan writes the spawn line
limitations: Matches compare box sizes (length, width, height), aspect and roof shape only; the catalogue has no colours except colour words in a few row or material names, so colour rarely decides.
A stand-in is the nearest catalogue shape, not the real object: look at it next to scan_view.
Vehicle heading is known only up to 180 degrees (front / back look alike from above).
